caption: 60 s; normal 5/6, pilots; runtime SPI, FEC, mapping and shaping. Finite GPIO capture checked; on-chip payload emulation; no AFE/RF qualification.
scope: One RP2350, two cores, stock clocks/voltage, USB only; on-chip PV-SPI source, real GCS/BB/BCH/LDPC, standard16/32APSK PL framing, continuous native L8/N2 FIR, DMA and PIO.
capacity: BB data-field capacity after80-bit BBHEADER; includes any GCS packet headers/padding inside that field. It is not application goodput or external SPI qualification.
selection: Exactly one clean60s trial per modulation and clock in the four supplied campaigns; these qualified points do not assert a global maximum.
uncertainty: Finite-run deterministic output-clock rates; no inferred confidence intervals or unmeasured headroom.
validation: All8192 contiguous GPIO halfwords, including one complete90-symbol PLHEADER, revalidated at one bounded offset in finite real FEC frames; no cyclic replay.
